context-economy.title: TIKAZ Context Economy for Codex
context-economy.tagline: A fidelity-first multimodal context compiler for the smallest useful context that remains checkable.

proofs.label_zh: 固定长上下文估算减少
proofs.note_en: Six fixed tasks: 4,698 to 1,422 estimated tokens
proofs.note_zh: 6 个固定任务：估算 Token 从 4,698 降至 1,422

proofs.note_en: Six fixed prompt cases: 252 to 182 estimated tokens
proofs.note_zh: 6 个固定提示词样例：估算 Token 从 252 降至 182

proofs.note_en: Literal recall on declared protected facts
proofs.note_zh: 声明保护事实的字面召回，不等同语义准确率

proofs.label_zh: 生成 PDF 字面检查
proofs.note_en: Text, numbers, tables, and page anchors; visual accuracy pending
proofs.note_zh: 文字、数字、表格和页锚点；视觉准确率待测

highlights: Paste text or attach files and let the workflow choose Text / Hybrid / Source automatically
Document-to-Markdown preparation compacts text while retaining page anchors, protected facts, table checks, and unresolved visual evidence
Documents with images split into compact text, visual relevance filtering, bounded vision work, and source fallback instead of sending every page blindly
prompts: Process my pasted text or attached files for this task. Automatically choose Text, Hybrid, or Source, prepare reusable Markdown where safe, retain protected facts and anchors, and make every omission visible.
This document contains images or tables. Compact the text separately, skip decorative and duplicate visuals, queue only task-relevant visual evidence, and preserve uncertain source pages.
Create a recoverable checkpoint from this long conversation. Preserve decisions, constraints, completed evidence, file paths, numbers, commands, and open questions.

frontend-design.title: TIKAZ Frontend Design for Codex
frontend-design.tagline: Art-directed frontend workflows that prove the visual direction before scaling implementation.

proofs.note_en: Marketing, product, editorial, and dense utility surfaces
proofs.note_zh: 营销、产品、编辑与高密度工具界面

proofs.note_en: Desktop and mobile direction before full expansion
proofs.note_zh: 完整扩展前先验证桌面端与移动端方向

proofs.label_zh: 设计到代码单一责任人
proofs.note_en: One workflow owns direction, implementation, and handoff
proofs.note_zh: 同一工作流负责方向、实现与交付

proofs.label_zh: 真实渲染 QA 检查
proofs.note_en: Responsive, overflow, contrast, and reduced-motion checks
proofs.note_zh: 响应式、溢出、对比度与减少动态效果检查

highlights: Four product-surface modes instead of one landing-page aesthetic
Design Read and three project dials before implementation
Revision-bound desktop/mobile proof and engineering QA
prompts: Redesign this dashboard. Classify the surface and approve a desktop/mobile art-direction proof before expanding the full product.
Audit this interface for generic visual patterns, then distill it without turning it into a marketing page.
Create a DESIGN.md for this app, implement the representative viewport, and verify responsive and reduced-motion states.

video-intelligence.title: TIKAZ Video Intelligence for Codex
video-intelligence.tagline: Evidence-graded video reading with timestamps, keyframes, source cards, and cross-video synthesis.

proofs.note_en: From metadata-only reading to primary-source verification
proofs.note_zh: 从仅元数据阅读到第一手来源核验

proofs.note_en: Transcript, visual observation, external verification, and inference
proofs.note_zh: 字幕、视觉观察、外部核验与推断相互分离

proofs.note_en: Transcript, ASR, and task-relevant keyframes
proofs.note_zh: 字幕、语音识别与任务相关关键帧

proofs.note_en: Claims retain time anchors, evidence level, confidence, and fallback state
proofs.note_zh: 主张保留时间锚点、证据等级、置信度与降级状态

highlights: Five evidence levels from metadata to primary-source verification
Transcript, visual observation, external verification, and inference stay separate
Partial failures remain visible in the source ledger
prompts: Compare these videos with timestamps and label the evidence level behind every important claim.
Read this local lecture, inspect keyframes where the transcript is insufficient, and produce an auditable source card.
Synthesize these tutorials, show disagreements and missing dependencies, then recommend a workflow with confidence levels.

engineering.title: TIKAZ Engineering Workflows for Codex
engineering.tagline: Production delivery from specification and impact mapping to tests, review, and release evidence.

proofs.note_en: Specification, impact, implementation, tests, review, and release
proofs.note_zh: 规格、影响、实现、测试、审查与发布

proofs.note_en: One workflow owns acceptance criteria through handoff
proofs.note_zh: 同一工作流从验收条件负责到最终交付

proofs.note_en: Repository-native tests and static checks remain authoritative
proofs.note_zh: 以仓库原生测试和静态检查为准

proofs.note_en: Commands, outcomes, risks, and rollback stay visible
proofs.note_zh: 命令、结果、风险与回滚信息保持可见

highlights: One lifecycle owner from acceptance criteria to handoff
Unified clean-room code intelligence for architecture and impact
Security, Supabase, and video-workbench adapters route without expanding scope
prompts: Map the impact of this API change, implement it in small slices, and provide test and rollback evidence.
Review this unfamiliar repository and produce an architecture map before proposing a cross-file refactor.
Audit this third-party Skill for credential, permission, dependency, and prompt-injection risks before installation.

knowledge-research.title: TIKAZ Knowledge & Research for Codex
knowledge-research.tagline: Traceable research and decisions with evidence ledgers, disagreement, confidence, and knowledge feedback.

proofs.note_en: One orchestrator and five focused research specialists
proofs.note_zh: 1 个编排器与 5 个专项研究 Skill

proofs.note_en: Claims, evidence, confidence, and recommendation stay linked
proofs.note_zh: 主张、证据、置信度与建议保持关联

proofs.note_en: Personal knowledge changes execution only after explicit review
proofs.note_zh: 个人知识仅在明确审查后才影响执行

proofs.note_en: Contrary evidence and unresolved claims are not flattened
proofs.note_zh: 相反证据与未决主张不会被抹平

highlights: Question and evidence threshold are fixed before synthesis
Conversion, retrieval, evidence, inference, and recommendation remain distinct
Personal knowledge is adopted only when it changes execution
prompts: Compare these papers with inclusion criteria, contrary evidence, confidence, and claims that need revalidation.
Convert this document to Markdown, inspect fidelity, then extract decision-ready claims without inventing citations.
Retrieve relevant personal project decisions and record only knowledge that materially changes the plan.

presentation.title: TIKAZ Presentation Workflows for Codex
presentation.tagline: Narrative-first HTML, PPTX, and editorial web decks with page contracts and rendered QA.

proofs.note_en: HTML deck, editable PPTX, and editorial web presentation
proofs.note_zh: HTML 演示、可编辑 PPTX 与编辑式网页演示

proofs.note_en: Exactly one builder owns the final artifact
proofs.note_zh: 最终成品只由一个构建器负责

proofs.note_en: Each page defines claim, evidence, visual job, and speaker intent
proofs.note_zh: 每页定义主张、证据、视觉任务与讲述意图

proofs.note_en: Overflow, collisions, media licensing, and artifact integrity
proofs.note_zh: 溢出、碰撞、媒体授权与成品完整性

highlights: Choose exactly one output builder for each final deck
Every slide receives a claim, evidence, visual job, and speaker intent
Rendered overflow, media licensing, and final artifact integrity are completion gates
prompts: Choose HTML or PPTX for this talk, write page contracts, and render representative pages before completing the deck.
Create an editable PowerPoint from this brief and inspect every dense slide for overflow and collisions.
Turn this essay into a single-file editorial web deck with restrained motion and offline verification.

visual-content.title: TIKAZ Visual Content for Codex
visual-content.tagline: Provider-neutral illustration, concise writing, and lawful music workflows with publishing QA.

proofs.note_en: One orchestrator and four focused content specialists
proofs.note_zh: 1 个编排器与 4 个内容专项 Skill

proofs.note_en: Article metaphor and logistics explainer systems
proofs.note_zh: 文章隐喻与物流科普信息图体系

proofs.note_en: One visual identity and one shot card own each asset
proofs.note_zh: 每项资产由一种视觉身份和一张 Shot Card 负责

proofs.note_en: Labels, claims, alt text, legibility, license, and attribution
proofs.note_zh: 标签、事实、替代文本、可读性、授权与署名

highlights: One visual identity and one shot card own each asset
Chinese labels, factual claims, alt text, and publishing-size legibility are verified
Music discovery retains license and attribution evidence
prompts: Turn this essay into one original hand-drawn metaphor with a shot card, verified Chinese labels, and alt text.
Explain this warehouse process as a sourced 16:9 logistics diagram with aligned nodes and explicit exceptions.
Remove filler from this caption, then find lawful music and retain the download and attribution evidence.
